b2b-conference-sales-marketing.purpose: Turn public conference evidence into sales and marketing actions without mass scraping or unsourced outreach.

create_outreach_task_only_when: participation evidence is official or corroborated
company is a target account, competitor, partner candidate or strong ICP match
recommended action has owner and due date
marketing_content_candidate_when: topic appears across at least two companies or sessions
topic maps to campaign, content brief, use case or objection
source confidence is medium or high
block_action_when: participation is inferred from attendee-list vendor pages
source access is restricted, paid or licensed without approval
personal data would be copied into broad pages

methods.expected_strength: fast source discovery and citation capture
methods.expected_gap: may miss JavaScript-rendered filters, sessions and hidden cards

methods.expected_strength: can inspect dynamic pages, filters, tabs and screenshots
methods.expected_gap: manual and session-state dependent; less reusable

methods.expected_strength: can turn long-horizon browser tasks into scripts, logs and repeatable artifacts
methods.expected_gap: requires local setup, isolated workspace, dependency review and approval before real runs

collection_method_comparison.production_write_policy: never during method comparison; staged report only
